query: SELECT f.name, fs.transactionType, fs.antiMoneyLaunderingFee, COUNT(*) as bands FROM firm_fee_structures fs JOIN law_firms f ON f.id = fs.firmId GROUP BY f.name, fs.transactionType, fs.antiMoneyLaunderingFee ORDER BY f.name, fs.transactionType;
